title: Dropping a Linux/Windows Locating lookup cancels nothing: cancel() is a no-op and the thread keeps its GeoClue client for up to 20 s
trigger: Open Send Location, then close the picker (or switch account) while 'locating'
effect: The GeoClue client (location indicator in the desktop shell) stays started until the fix or the 20 s timeout; its answer is sent to a dropped Receiver
fix: hold a cancel token (AtomicBool/oneshot) in Locating that the lookup selects on alongside the timer

title: chat_preview_overlay draws its loading skeleton from requests.has_purpose_for_chat(GetChatPreview, chat) instead of the chat_preview_fetch Fetch it already reads
trigger: Peek preview of a chat while another window/older request for the same chat is in flight
effect: busy state is read by purpose+chat id, not by the RequestId held in the Fetch (same shape the request-match guard rejects for has_purpose); no wrong output seen because one request per chat

title: send_message_report_text clears the report details field even when report_messages could not be sent
trigger: Report > a reason that needs details > type text > Report while the send is refused (driver Err): the note says 'Could not send the report' and the flow stays on TextRequired
effect: The typed details are gone and must be retyped
fix: clear the field only when the send was accepted (or when the flow leaves TextRequired)

title: The Instant View reader (Session::messages.instant_view) has no closer in MessageUi's Farewell, so it comes back after switching accounts and back
trigger: Open an Instant View link in account A (the full-window reader overlay shows), switch to account B (replace_screen), switch back to A
effect: A's reader overlay (opaque, inset_0, occludes the chat) is drawn again over the restored screen until the user presses Esc or its close button; sibling session-held boxes (message_report, replies_block) are closed by this very Farewell for the same reason
fix: close it in MessageUi::farewell (session.messages.instant_view = None) or hold the reader in an OnScreen-owned enum

title: ParagraphText keeps click_ranges, actions and link_flags as three parallel Vecs that every push site must extend together
trigger: Any new run kind in paragraph_text (a sixth push site) that pushes a range and an action but forgets link_flags (or the reverse)
effect: None today: all seven push sites extend the three together; the consumer zips them by index, so a miss would shift every later click target and hover underline

title: scope/reaction notification settings are sent as a full object built from the session snapshot, so two quick toggles lose the first
trigger: Open Notifications defaults; toggle 'Show message preview' then, before TDLib's updateScopeNotificationSettings arrives, toggle 'Notify about mentions' for the same scope (same for apply_reaction_*)
effect: The second send carries the old preview value, so the server ends with the first change reverted and the switch snaps back
fix: Keep a per-scope Edit stage (draft + request id) in the settings ui and merge the next field into the in-flight draft, or send field-level patches

title: avatar decode 'in flight' is a thread_local map entry (empty Vec) with no Task, cleared only by a detached task
trigger: A first notification for an avatar starts the decode; if the app task never reaches the remove (spawn_app task dropped, app update failing before the remove)
effect: No bug today; later notifications for that photo path queue behind a decode nobody will finish and never show
fix: Hold the decode as a stage (Decoding { job: Task }) in NotifyDelivery keyed by path, so dropping it ends the wait

title: Shown::sending holds one Sending per (account, chat), so two Notify calls in flight for the same chat share one withdrawal mark
trigger: Two messages for one chat arrive together (two workers call show); the chat is read (close) while both Notify calls are on the bus
effect: The first land consumes the Withdrawn mark and closes only its own id; the second toast lands with no mark and stays up although the chat was read
fix: key sending by a per-call ticket (call id) and withdraw all tickets of the chat

title: the capability probe thread loops forever at REPROBE while the daemon is Missing, whether the app is locked, hidden or notifications are off
trigger: Run without a notification daemon: quill-notify-caps connects to the session bus every 30 s for the life of the process
effect: Wasted work only (a thread with a bare sleep, outside the owned-timers guard, which counts async timers)
fix: probe on demand (when the Notifications page or a first notification asks) behind a quill::wake signal, not on a clock

title: poll loop is a detached task named by connect.generation instead of a task held by the client
trigger: restart_live_connection / client replaced: the old loop ends only when it next wakes and compares generation
fix: hold the poll Task in the LiveConnect stage so replacing the client cancels it

title: Pay on a composer paid-send confirmation resubmits the text, which opens the same confirmation again unless 'Don't ask me again' is ticked
trigger: Live account; open a chat whose other side charges Stars; type text and Send; the Confirm payment box opens; leave 'Don't ask me again' unticked and press Pay
effect: confirm_paid_send replaces the stage with None and calls submit_composer, whose live branch (composer/mod.rs:174) calls paid_send_waits again; needs_confirmation is still true (the price is not trusted), so a new Composer stage is made and the box reopens. The message never goes out unless the user ticks the trust box (which stores a price they did not want to remember). The unit tests run on the demo session where `plan` is None and the check is skipped
fix: Make Pay hand the submit an 'agreed for this send' value (a field of the Composer stage carried into the one resubmit) that paid_send_waits honours once, or send through the PaidGuard release path instead of resubmitting

title: CardInput::invalid and CardForm::country_invalid are error flags set by Done and cleared by the next edit of the same field, beside the text they judge
trigger: Press Done with a bad number (show_card_error sets invalid); edit another field
effect: No bug today; the mark is about the text at that moment but is a bool not tied to it (TitleCheck in new_chat holds the judged text instead)
fix: FieldCheck { Fine, Rejected(judged text) } compared with the current text

title: Backspace/Delete snapshot is cleared by two nested defers matched by a press counter
trigger: Press Backspace in a card field; DeleteEdit::Pending{press} is cleared by a defer-of-a-defer comparing `press`
effect: No bug today; the counter tells an old defer from the current press (the shape the timers guard names)
fix: take the snapshot in the Change handler of the same effect cycle (one place), or hold it in a stage that the Change consumes and the next frame drops
